ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text:
Electric bicycles have become one of the important means of transportation for urban travel. The nameplate of a certain brand of electric bicycle is shown in the table below. A citizen with a mass of $60\mathrm{kg}$ rides the electric bicycle driven solely by the motor at the rated power along a straight road starting from rest. The maximum speed the electric bicycle can reach is $7\mathrm{m/s}$. It is known that the resistance experienced by the electric bicycle is 0.05 times the total weight of the person and the bicycle, and the gravitational acceleration $g$ is taken as $10\mathrm{m}/\mathrm{s}^{2}$.

1. The electrical energy consumed by the motor within 5 minutes; do not add any other content.
2. The output power of the motor; do not add any other content.
3. The internal resistance $r$ of the motor coil.

ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: Electric bicycles have become one of the important means of transportation for urban travel. The nameplate of a certain brand of electric bicycle is shown in the table below. A citizen with a mass of $60\mathrm{kg}$ rides the electric bicycle driven solely by the motor at the rated power along a straight road starting from rest. The maximum speed the electric bicycle can reach is $7\mathrm{m/s}$. It is known that the resistance experienced by the electric bicycle is 0.05 times the total weight of the person and the bicycle, and the gravitational acceleration $g$ is taken as $10\mathrm{m}/\mathrm{s}^{2}$. 1. The electrical energy consumed by the motor within 5 minutes; do not add any other content. 2. The output power of the motor; do not add any other content. 3. The internal resistance $r$ of the motor coil.
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure is an electric bicycle nameplate table. In the table, “Rated Power: 360W”, “Rated Voltage: 36V”, and “Total weight: 40kg” can be read. Reasoning: According to the meaning of the question and the method, the electric bicycle is operated by the motor at rated power, 5 min = 300 s, so the electric energy consumed is E = Pt = 360 W × 300 s = 1.08 × 10^5 J. The rider’s mass is 60 kg, and the bicycle’s mass is taken as 40 kg from the nameplate, so the total mass is 100 kg; the resistance is 0.05 times the total weight, namely F = 0.05 × 100 kg × 10 m/s² = 50 N. When the maximum speed 7 m/s is reached, the traction force equals the resistance, so the motor output power P_out = Fv = 50 N × 7 m/s = 350 W. The rated voltage is 36 V and the rated input power is 360 W, therefore the current I = P/U = 360/36 = 10 A. The coil loss power P_loss = 360 W − 350 W = 10 W, and from P_loss = I²r, obtain r = 10/10² = 0.1 Ω.
